Alphas land slowly on the plate;
their charge is collected at the
One or two stages is the builder's choice. The collector voltage is set just under the alpha energy divided by 2e, and is reset for each operating mode.
The alphas are nearly all at one energy, so a single plate can recover most of it. Slower alphas that cannot reach the plate are turned back and are caught by the optional stage.
The plate runs at a steady DC voltage. It needs no coil and no tuned circuit, and it does not depend on how the alphas are bunched.
